    (longestCommonSubsequence s1 s2 h_precond).length = s1.length

specs.name: longestCommonSubsequence_result_chars_in_s1
specs.stmt:
∀ (s1 : String) (s2 : String) (h_precond : longestCommonSubsequence_precond s1 s2),
    ∀ c ∈ (longestCommonSubsequence s1 s2 h_precond).toList,
    c ∈ s1.toList

specs.name: longestCommonSubsequence_is_common_subseq
specs.stmt:
∀ (s1 : String) (s2 : String) (h_precond : longestCommonSubsequence_precond s1 s2),
    let result := longestCommonSubsequence s1 s2 h_precond
    let allSubseq (arr : List Char) := (arr.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    (allSubseq s1.toList).filter (fun l => (allSubseq s2.toList).contains l) |>.contains result.toList

specs.name: longestCommonSubsequence_length_symmetric
specs.stmt:
∀ (s1 : String) (s2 : String) (h_precond : longestCommonSubsequence_precond s1 s2)
    (h_precond2 : longestCommonSubsequence_precond s2 s1),
    (longestCommonSubsequence s1 s2 h_precond).length =
    (longestCommonSubsequence s2 s1 h_precond2).length

specs.name: longestCommonSubsequence_is_longest
specs.stmt:
∀ (s1 : String) (s2 : String) (h_precond : longestCommonSubsequence_precond s1 s2),
    let result := longestCommonSubsequence s1 s2 h_precond
    let allSubseq (arr : List Char) := (arr.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let commonSubseq := (allSubseq s1.toList).filter (fun l => (allSubseq s2.toList).contains l)
    commonSubseq.all (fun l => l.length = result.length)
